mapper.select: SELECT customer_id,status,inventory_status,RTRIM(shipment_intent_key) AS shipment_intent_key FROM shop_orders WHERE id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT order_id,order_line_id,quantity,status,warehouse_id FROM order_line_refund_admissions WHERE case_id=#{caseId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND id=#{orderLineId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_line_refund_admissions WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND status='HELD'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity),0) FROM order_line_refund_admissions WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND order_line_id=#{orderLineId} AND status='SETTLED' AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId}
mapper.update: UPDATE order_line_refund_admissions SET status=#{status} WHERE case_id=#{caseId} AND status='HELD'

UPDATE shop_orders SET status='REFUNDED',inventory_status='REFUNDED',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status IN ('PAID','CONFIRMED') AND shipment_intent_key IS NULL AND (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM order_items WHERE order_id=#{orderId}) = (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM order_line_refund_admissions WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND status='SETTLED')
mapper.select: SELECT i.id,i.product_id,i.merchant_id,i.product_name,i.thumbnail_url,i.unit_price, i.quantity-COALESCE(r.quantity,0) AS quantity,i.subtotal,i.discount_amount FROM order_items i LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_line_id,SUM(quantity) AS quantity FROM order_line_refund_admissions WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND status='SETTLED' GROUP BY order_line_id ) r ON i.id=r.order_line_id WHERE i.order_id=#{orderId} AND i.quantity>COALESCE(r.quantity,0) ORDER BY i.id
